# Test basic CSV
assert csv_rows("a,b,c") == [["a", "b", "c"]], (csv_rows("a,b,c"), [["a", "b", "c"]])

# Test multiple rows
assert csv_rows("a,b\nc,d") == [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], (csv_rows("a,b\nc,d"), [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]])

# Test CRLF line endings
assert csv_rows("a,b\r\nc,d\r\n") == [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], (csv_rows("a,b\r\nc,d\r\n"), [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]])

# Test quoted field with comma
assert csv_rows('"a,b",c') == [["a,b", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a,b",c'), [["a,b", "c"]])

# Test quoted field with newline
assert csv_rows('"a\nb",c') == [["a\nb", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a\nb",c'), [["a\nb", "c"]])

# Test quoted field with CRLF
assert csv_rows('"a\r\nb",c') == [["a\r\nb", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a\r\nb",c'), [["a\r\nb", "c"]])

# Test doubled quotes as escaped quote
assert csv_rows('"a""b",c') == [["a\"b", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a""b",c'), [["a\"b", "c"]])

# Test multiple doubled quotes
assert csv_rows('"a""""b",c') == [["a\"\"b", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a""""b",c'), [["a\"\"b", "c"]])

# Test empty fields
assert csv_rows("a,,c") == [["a", "", "c"]], (csv_rows("a,,c"), [["a", "", "c"]])

# Test empty quoted field
assert csv_rows('""') == [[""]], (csv_rows('""'), [[""]])

# Test empty input
assert csv_rows("") == [], (csv_rows(""), [])

# Test single field
assert csv_rows("a") == [["a"]], (csv_rows("a"), [["a"]])

# Test quoted field with spaces
assert csv_rows('" a ",b') == [[" a ", "b"]], (csv_rows('" a ",b'), [[" a ", "b"]])

# Test field with leading/trailing spaces unquoted
assert csv_rows(" a ,b") == [[" a ", "b"]], (csv_rows(" a ,b"), [[" a ", "b"]])

# Test multiple rows with quoted fields
assert csv_rows('"a,b",c\n"d,e",f') == [["a,b", "c"], ["d,e", "f"]], (csv_rows('"a,b",c\n"d,e",f'), [["a,b", "c"], ["d,e", "f"]])

# Test quoted field with comma and newline
assert csv_rows('"a,b\nc",d') == [["a,b\nc", "d"]], (csv_rows('"a,b\nc",d'), [["a,b\nc", "d"]])

# Test quoted field with comma and CRLF
assert csv_rows('"a,b\r\nc",d') == [["a,b\r\nc", "d"]], (csv_rows('"a,b\r\nc",d'), [["a,b\r\nc", "d"]])

# Test quoted field with escaped quote and comma
assert csv_rows('"a""b,c",d') == [["a\"b,c", "d"]], (csv_rows('"a""b,c",d'), [["a\"b,c", "d"]])

# Test quoted field with escaped quote and newline
assert csv_rows('"a""b\nc",d') == [["a\"b\nc", "d"]], (csv_rows('"a""b\nc",d'), [["a\"b\nc", "d"]])

# Test trailing newline
assert csv_rows("a,b\n") == [["a", "b"]], (csv_rows("a,b\n"), [["a", "b"]])

# Test trailing CRLF
assert csv_rows("a,b\r\n") == [["a", "b"]], (csv_rows("a,b\r\n"), [["a", "b"]])

# Test multiple trailing newlines
assert csv_rows("a,b\n\n") == [["a", "b"], []], (csv_rows("a,b\n\n"), [["a", "b"], []])

# Test multiple trailing CRLFs
assert csv_rows("a,b\r\n\r\n") == [["a", "b"], []], (csv_rows("a,b\r\n\r\n"), [["a", "b"], []])

# Test empty row in middle
assert csv_rows("a,b\n\nc,d") == [["a", "b"], [], ["c", "d"]], (csv_rows("a,b\n\nc,d"), [["a", "b"], [], ["c", "d"]])

# Test quoted empty field in middle
assert csv_rows('a,"",c') == [["a", "", "c"]], (csv_rows('a,"",c'), [["a", "", "c"]])

# Test all quoted fields
assert csv_rows('"a","b","c"') == [["a", "b", "c"]], (csv_rows('"a","b","c"'), [["a", "b", "c"]])

# Test mixed quoted and unquoted
assert csv_rows('a,"b",c') == [["a", "b", "c"]], (csv_rows('a,"b",c'), [["a", "b", "c"]])

# Test field with only quotes
assert csv_rows('"""',) == [['"']], (csv_rows('"""'), [['"']])

# Test field with quote at start and end
assert csv_rows('"a"') == [["a"]], (csv_rows('"a"'), [["a"]])

# Test field with quote in middle unquoted
assert csv_rows('a"b') == [['a"b']], (csv_rows('a"b'), [['a"b']])

# Test complex case with multiple edge cases
assert csv_rows('"a,b","c\nd","e""f"\r\n"1","2","3"') == [["a,b", "c\nd", "e\"f"], ["1", "2", "3"]], (csv_rows('"a,b","c\nd","e""f"\r\n"1","2","3"'), [["a,b", "c\nd", "e\"f"], ["1", "2", "3"]])

def csv_rows(text):

    field = []
    in_quotes = False
    i = 0
    n = len(text)
    
    while i < n:
        c = text[i]
        
        if in_quotes:
            if c == '"':
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '"':
                    field.append('"')
                    i += 2
                    continue
                else:
                    in_quotes = False
                    i += 1
                    continue
            else:
                field.append(c)
                i += 1
                continue
        else:
            if c == '"':
                in_quotes = True
                i += 1
                continue
            elif c == ',':
                row.append(''.join(field))
                field = []
                i += 1
                continue
            elif c == '\r':
                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == '\n':
                    row.append(''.join(field))
                    field = []
                    rows.append(row)
                    row = []
                    i += 2
                    continue
                else:
                    row.append(''.join(field))
                    field = []
                    rows.append(row)
                    row = []
                    i += 1
                    continue
            elif c == '\n':
                row.append(''.join(field))
                field = []
                rows.append(row)
                row = []
                i += 1
                continue
            else:
                field.append(c)
                i += 1
                continue
    
    # Handle the last field/row
    if field or row:
        row.append(''.join(field))
        rows.append(row)
    
    return rows
